explanations.measures: Receivables and stock growing faster than sales.
explanations.deterioration: Customers paying slower, or stock not moving.
explanations.innocent: Stock built for a launch, or bigger customers on longer terms.

explanations.measures: Share count rising while return on capital falls.
explanations.innocent: A recent acquisition not yet earning.

explanations.measures: Goodwill as a share of assets.

explanations.measures: Year-to-year movement in the tax rate.
explanations.innocent: Changed profit mix, settlements, rate changes.

explanations.measures: Share-based pay as a share of revenue.
explanations.deterioration: A cost that dilutes holders without touching cash.
